description: Public omo documentation at a pinned revision plus the existing fictional multilingual recall corpus. No private user memories. Documents are projected as notes without changing the sources.

projection.description: first ATX heading, otherwise source basename

rules: Independent sessions may read only this manifest and the shared corpus, never the other author's questions or benchmark results.
Each row has id, split, slice, query, gold paths, evidence quote and optional expansions (synonyms/keywords/related/noteLine).
Questions and expansions are frozen before any retrieval execution; expansions model search-time author intent, not a live model benchmark.
Practice and evaluation must ask different facts; do not copy the fixture's existing questions.
At least half of each split targets long public documents; include short multilingual notes and ambiguous nearby distractors.
Gold paths include all corpus notes that genuinely answer the question, not every document sharing vocabulary.
The paraphrase slice uses indirect descriptions rather than quoted source keywords; other slices classify query language.
